free_tier.stated: 'Up to $10,000 can be awarded for each proposal'. Eligibility: 'Any NumFOCUS Fiscally Sponsored or Affiliated project is eligible to submit 1 proposal per grant cycle. Each project may receive a maximum of 2 grants per calendar year', and 'Proposals may be submitted by residents of any country'.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: This is the natural home for a scientific-computing tool, so the route is: get the project affiliated, then take USD 10,000 three times a year.

limits.value: The applicant must be an existing NumFOCUS fiscally sponsored or affiliated project before the grant exists, which is the whole gate; a person with a useful repository and no affiliation cannot submit.
